## Changelog
Don't edit `CHANGELOG.md`. If SDK consumers would notice this change, add one new file
`changelog.d/<short-kebab-description>.md` with `### Added` / `### Changed` / `### Removed` /
`### Fixed` bullets (format in `changelog.d/README.md`).

- [ ] Added a `changelog.d/` note
- [ ] Pure chore — no consumer-visible change, no note needed
